notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I’m very happy and proud to announce the release date of my first developed game ever. After years of hard work in my spare time, [b]The First Mine[/b] will be released on Steam at [b]October 30, 2025[/b].

Best regards,
Stefan

[b]Game Trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube="v3upt8jOmCA;full"][/previewyoutube]
[b]Game Description:[/b]

The goal of [b]The First Mine[/b] is to mine as much gold as possible to achieve a high score at the end. There are different game sizes and difficulty levels to choose from, as well as several characters with unique traits for varied gameplay.

Each round you have to cleverly place and group a new random resource tile and upgrade your existing tiles as needed. Placing a new tile end the current round, mine gold in your mine and collect resources like wood, stone, wheat and fish.

To mine gold, you need people in your villages. To keep them, you need to provide enough wheat and fish each round. More people and a higher level increases the amount of gold produced per round. You need wood and stone to upgrade the level.

In order to increase your yield per round, you can solve different tasks and observe the requirements when placing tiles. In addition, there are random game events like trade, raids or natural disasters that can influence the game in a positive or negative way.
